test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U, are watching a movie sitting in a line, all facing the north. S is sitting between P and Q. T is at second place to the left of P. R is third to the left of Q. Q is sitting at one of the corners. Who is sitting at the other corner?
solution:
Six persons, P, Q, R, S, T and U, are watching a movie sitting in a line, all facing the north.

1) Q is sitting at one of the corners.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd84240b0928bdb5e208d06fa46defde2c86b34625126bdce6b65014a2b0abf5.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62894dd0a1e12c43f7675615f9c824d16d9668ec1d3aafd4e9f521b05d4c3d56.png] 

2) S is sitting between P and Q.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e25d60519644658a0c2553ad0656059f0e8ca037f17dc251634e6a629e2be5af.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc6aa0c43330392a2b0ebca9659b0374d9346985fd0140eebb862e77f997bf14.png] 

3) T is at second place to the left of P.

Here case (i) gets eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eab309903bf8aaa0b58e876fb769a04aad08d1fa5068e5258bab3a85060858f.png] 

4) R is third to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dbe5dff54bac5ac414d2443147530710c2f78c74c664ad99e2f0b12317d0c25.png] 

6) Position of all six persons.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58d11a4f1a2e750501a89beb819dd0f54a9d394da843daa84b4efd0ce8f098b5.png] 

∴ Here, 'U' is sitting in other corner.

Hence, the correct answer is **"U".**
